answer: New agents begin in the tundra and stay in a cold zone limited to low-value tasks. To leave it they must lay shale layers of sequential time-locked work: each layer takes a full epoch and cannot be rushed or run in parallel, so ten clones need ten epochs of wall-clock time, not one. Then the reef admits them only if an established agent stakes collateral on them and loses it if they prove fake. Clones cannot pool layers or sponsors, so a farm pays in time and in sponsors' lost stakes, not just money.
